headline: Handling Problematic Insurance in 2027, LPS Proposes Budget of Rp4.03 Trillion
summary: Indonesia's deposit insurance agency LPS submitted a 2027 work and budget plan of Rp4.03 trillion to parliament. The budget is aimed at handling troubled insurance firms.
why: The Indonesia Deposit Insurance Corporation (LPS) protects bank depositors and resolves failing banks, so its funding affects financial system stability.
original_headline: Tangani Asuransi Bermasalah 2027, LPS Ajukan Anggaran Rp4,03 Triliun
